fallback.trigger: fewer than 52 common active observations, nonfinite/nonpositive covariance, or nonfinite portfolio volatility

gate_b_ledger.reconciliation: normalized_mode_notional=min(pre_normalization_mode_notional×realized_capital_multiplier, frozen native requested stake, preissue bankroll); actual funded stake is then exact integer water-fill and may be lower only from caps/atomicity/rounding/cash

leverage.reason: normalization may resize down but never create exposure above the frozen native request

methods.EQUAL_CAPITAL: multiplier=1; equal target capital across currently active sleeves before capped integer water-fill; executable only with EQUAL_WEIGHT, otherwise explicit INAPPLICABLE_METHOD_WEIGHT_COMBINATION
methods.RAW_UNNORMALIZED_CONTROL: multiplier=1; reports frozen native-capital exposure without volatility targeting; diagnostic/control, not an Edge or risk-adjusted promotion claim
methods.UNIT_CAPITAL: multiplier=1; issue risk_budget_yuan=pre-normalization mode/bankroll budget; executable reference
methods.UNIT_EX_ANTE_VOL_CAPPED_5PCT: multiplier=min(1, 0.05/ex_ante_portfolio_volatility); this is a 5% target capped at one, not unconstrained unit-vol scaling; executable after 52 valid prior common-active observations

ordering: mode/bankroll issue budget and integer ticket funding

prior_volatility_estimator.covariance: unbiased sample covariance then 10% diagonal shrinkage
prior_volatility_estimator.return: native/fixed-capital pre-tax sleeve return on strictly-prior common active issue rows only
